title: Research: exact screen of mixed rank-six child blocks
body:
**Scoped negative result. No new supplier or κ is claimed.**

This package tests the exact block-diagonal fusion `(2,2,1,1) -> 6`:
`diag(A2,B2,a,b) diag(C2,D2,c,d) = diag(A2 C2,B2 D2,ac,bd)`. The direct sum preserves paid rank mass six while replacing two rank-two and two rank-one children with one rank-six child.

The source-pinned search enumerates all consecutive four-event windows in both complete orientations of the selected gauge44 provider. It finds 28 eligible windows per orientation and a maximum of 13 disjoint fusions. The ideal transformed profile is `{1:2386,2:392,3:432,4:142,5:82,6:13,8:8}` with mass 5,586. Even after granting zero cost to all source, copy, gather, output, frame, hosting, precision and restoration work, its exact ceiling upper endpoint is `1698446697/1000000000000`, below the 5% target `3549113631/2000000000000`. At least 126 zero-charge fusions would be required; 125 fails and 126 passes the exact target brackets.

This is limited to the pinned `(2,2,1,1)` child shape and strict contiguous windows. PR #1779 covers homogeneous rank-one batches; PR #1866 uses a different `(3,1,1,1)->6` tensor; open PR #1960 optimizes rank-two/rank-three blocks. This package adds the rank-one/rank-two mixed shape and its source census over both full orientations.

**Reproduction**

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank6-hetero21-seedfb19 --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank6-hetero21-seedfb19
```

The package metadata check and direct verifier pass locally under Python 3.14; Python 3.12 is unavailable on this host. The selected-record check also passes. The registered replay uses Python 3.12 in CI.
